description: One tag with its per-type counts and everything it labels across the whole network (stories, areas, guidance, papers, …). Filter with types.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on the task you are doing. Never used to answer or rank; read only if a result is reported wrong.

page.description: Page number, 1-based (default 1). Use with `limit` to walk a long list.

slug.description: Tag slug, as find_tags returns it, e.g. "apis".

types.description: Only return tagged items of these types, e.g. ["posts"].

name: get_tag
